from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

kit = Path('Pottery Market - Print Kit.pdf')
guide = Path('Pottery Market - Setup Guide.pdf')
for path, page_count in [(kit, 6), (guide, 1)]:
    info = subprocess.check_output(['pdfinfo', path], text=True)
    assert re.search(rf'"'^Pages:'"\\s+{page_count}"'$'"', info, re.M)
    assert '612 x 792 pts (letter)' in info
    assert 'Producer:' not in info and 'Author:' not in info
    proof = subprocess.check_output(['pdftotext', '-bbox', path, '-'], text=True)
    root = ET.fromstring(proof)
    for word in root.findall('.//{*}word'):
        x0, y0, x1, y1 = [float(word.get(key)) for key in ('xMin', 'yMin', 'xMax', 'yMax')]
        assert 36 <= x0 < x1 <= 576 and 30 <= y0 < y1 <= 762, (word.text, word.attrib)

pages = subprocess.check_output(['pdftotext', '-layout', kit, '-'], text=True).split('\\f')
assert all(s in pages[0] for s in ('Saturday', '11 a.m.–3 p.m.', 'uneven glaze color', 'slight asymmetry'))
assert 'DECORATIVE' in pages[2] and 'DECORATIVE' in pages[3]
assert 'DECORATIVE' not in pages[1]
assert all(s in pages[5] for s in ('"'$8'"', '"'$12'"', '"'$18'"'))
html = Path('Pottery Market - Price Card Editor.html').read_text()
svg = [ET.fromstring(s) for s in re.findall(r'<svg .*?</svg>', html, re.S)]
assert len(svg) == 6
for graphic in svg:
    assert set(el.attrib.get(a) for el in graphic.iter() for a in ('fill','stroke') if a in el.attrib) <= {'#000000', '#943c2d', 'none'}
sizes = lambda graphic: [(r.get('width'), r.get('height')) for r in graphic.findall('.//{*}rect')]
assert all(sizes(graphic) == [('248', '136')] for graphic in svg[1:4])
assert sizes(svg[5]) == [('248', '136')] * 6
print('Verified seven Letter pages, text within print margins, sale details, two ink colors, and exact card fit.')
